title: Usage Guidelines
subtitle: Best practices to avoid restrictions and bans
disclaimer: Important: These recommendations reduce risks, but do not guarantee that a number used on the unofficial API will never be restricted.

pontos: If the number is new or has been unused for more than 30 days, use the number for at least 7 days before scanning the QR Code in the app; 2 to 4 weeks is ideal.
Exchange real messages, receive replies, make calls and join groups.
Avoid large volumes of messages right after activating it in the app.
Fill in photo, description, address, website and email.
Keep the information consistent with the company.
Only send to customers who have given consent, to avoid reports.
Ask customers to save the number to their contacts.
Whenever possible, let the customer start the first contact.
Mass messaging. Usually used in marketing campaigns.
Hundreds of messages from a newly created number, especially standardized messages.
